# Sam's Website — Copilot Project Context

## Project Overview
Personal website styled as a walkable pixel-art village. Built with React + Vite frontend, Express + SQLite backend. Uses PixiJS 8 for 2D rendering.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: React 19, Vite 6, react-router-dom 7, PixiJS 8 (pixi.js)
- **Backend**: Express 4, better-sqlite3, bcrypt, JWT auth
- **DB**: SQLite at `backend/db/samwebsite.db`
- **Ports**: Backend = 3002, Frontend Vite dev = 5173 (proxy `/api` → 3002)
- **Sprites**: CuteFantasySprites pack (kenmi-art), 16px pixel art, rendered at 3× scale
- **Git Branch**: `feat/editer_overhaul` for tile editor work

## Database Tables

### Auth
- `users`: id, username, password_hash, created_at

### Garden System
- `garden_plants`: id, author_id, title, description, plant_type, grid_x, grid_y, growth_stage (0-4), wither_stage (0-2), water_count, sunshine_count, last_watered, last_touched, created_at
- `garden_settings`: id (always 1), grid_width, grid_height

### Tile Map System
- `tile_maps`: id, name (UNIQUE), width, height, created_at, updated_at
- `tile_map_layers`: id, map_id, layer_index (0=ground, 1=objects, 2=canopy), name; UNIQUE(map_id, layer_index); CASCADE
- `tile_map_cells`: id, layer_id, grid_x, grid_y, sheet, sprite_x, sprite_y, sprite_w, sprite_h, walkable, interactable, portal_target; UNIQUE(layer_id, grid_x, grid_y); CASCADE

### Other
- `posts`, `notes` — blog/sticky note content

## API Routes

### Tile Map (`/api/tilemap`)
- `GET /` — list all maps
- `POST /` — create map (auto-creates 3 layers) [auth]
- `GET /:id` — full map + layers + cells
- `PUT /:id` — update metadata [auth]
- `DELETE /:id` — cascade delete [auth]
- `PUT /:id/cells` — batch upsert cells (max 5000) [auth]
- `DELETE /:id/cells` — batch delete cells [auth]

### Garden (`/api/garden`)
- `GET /` — returns { plants, settings }
- `GET /types` — plant type names
- `POST /plant` — plant seed [auth]
- `POST /:id/water` — water [auth, owner]
- `POST /:id/wither` — advance wither [auth, owner]
- `POST /:id/revive` — undo wither [auth, owner]
- `POST /:id/sunshine` — visitor sunshine (no auth)
- `DELETE /:id` — remove plant [auth, owner]
- `PUT /settings` — resize grid [auth]

## Key Architecture Decisions

### Tile Editor
- 16px native tile size, 3× initial zoom (48px display)
- 3 layers: Ground (0), Objects (1), Canopy (2)
- On-demand sprite loading via `ensureSheet()` — loads sheets lazily on first paint, not all 500+ at init
- Sprite palette uses custom dropdown (not native `<select>`) for dark theme compatibility
- Manifest auto-generated by `scripts/generateSpriteManifest.cjs` from `public/sprites/` filesystem
- Auth required (admin-only editor)

### Runtime Renderer (TileMapRenderer.jsx)
- Renders any saved tile map from DB
- Player character: layered animated sprite (base + shoes + pants + shirt + hair)
- WASD movement with per-axis collision detection using walkable flags
- Smooth camera follow (lerp 0.08)
- Portal system: interactable tiles with portal_target → press E to navigate

### Village Page
- Loads map named "village" from DB
- Portal targets map to routes (garden→/garden, posts→/posts, etc.)
- Entry point for the walkable website experience

### Garden Canvas
- PixiJS 8 fullscreen canvas with player character
- Farm sim style: soil grid, crops, fence, forest border, decorations
- Plant types: sunflower, cactus, bonsai, herb, rose, vine, mushroom, fern
- Growth stages 0-4 (watering advances), wither stages 0-2 (manual)
- Seeded RNG (seed=42) for procedural forest/decoration placement

### Rendering
- `TextureStyle.defaultOptions.scaleMode = 'nearest'` for crisp pixel art
- All PixiJS usage is raw (not @pixi/react) via `new Application()` + `app.init()`
